description.en: Short shoots bear bundles of very narrow repeatedly forked leaves.
description.zh: 短枝生出成束极细反复二叉叶。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Czekanowskia, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Czekanowskia 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: Threadlike forks differ from Ginkgo's broad fan and Phoenicopsis's undivided straps.
distinctness.zh: 线状二叉叶区别于银杏宽扇叶及Phoenicopsis不分裂带叶。

modeling_brief.en: Use grouped thin angular ribbons emerging from compact short shoots; avoid needle-clump textures that conceal the forks.
modeling_brief.zh: 用成组细角状带片从紧凑短枝伸出，避免以针叶贴图掩盖分叉。

uncertainty: Museum specimen-level concept; precise reproductive linkage is excluded.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.

sources.title: Plants in the dinosaur world
sources.supports: Specimens of Czekanowskia, Phoenicopsis, Ginkgo and Baiera foliage.
